cues: The cell potential, or electromotive force, is the potential difference between the electrodes when no current flows.
Under standard conditions, E nought cell equals E nought of the cathode minus E nought of the anode, both written as reduction potentials.
If it comes out positive, the reaction runs as written.
If negative, you have written the cell backwards.
